title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds RAG agent quickstarts, example agent/tool-calling samples (Python + TS), and updates docs site with an agent guide and interoperable code snippets.
description: This PR adds a set of opinionated quickstarts and examples for building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents and tool-calling flows, and wires them into the docs site. Motivation: provide maintainable, tested starter code that demonstrates best practices for using Redwood's agent APIs, tool calling, and RAG templates so new users and internal teams have a canonical reference. Changes include: - new quickstart guides (docs + README examples) for Python and TypeScript agent/tool-calling patterns - a reusable RAG template under docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md with recommended prompt scaffolding, caching tips, and evaluation hooks - small updates to the docs site navigation and a new canonical agents guide page - example implementations for a tool-backed QA agent (search + web-scraper toy tool) and a vectorstore-backed RAG flow - unit-testable example code and CI checks for examples. Checklist: - [x] Quickstart prose and code samples reviewed - [x] Examples run in CI smoke tests - [x] Docs site navigation updated and builds clean - [x] Minor style/lint fixes applied For reviewers: focus on clarity of the quickstart narrative, API usage correctness (client/agent calls), and that no internal-only utilities are referenced. Linked Linear items: ENG-3412 (agent quickstarts), PM-89 (docs placement).
